name: Princess Cruises Rewards Visa® Card

apr.notes: Variable APR 18.49%–29.49% for purchases (based on creditworthiness); cash advance APR 29.74%. 0% introductory APR for 15 billing cycles on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening. Balance transfer fee: 5% (min. $5). Cash advance fee: 5% (min. $10). Minimum monthly interest charge $0.50.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee: 0%. No foreign transaction fees on purchases made while traveling abroad.

base_rate.description: Earn 1x Points per $1 spent on all other purchases.

categories.label: 2x Points on all Princess purchases including onboard purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem points for statement credits toward purchases on Princess and eligible airfare purchases, or redeem for onboard credit and amenities, gift cards and more. 20,000 bonus points can be redeemed for a $200 onboard credit toward your next cruise purchase.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 20,000 Bonus Points after spending $1,000 in qualifying purchases within the first 90 days — enough to redeem for a $200 onboard credit toward your next cruise purchase.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made while traveling abroad.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability Protection
benefits.description: You're not responsible for charges you did not authorize.

benefits.title: Low Intro APR on Balance Transfers
benefits.description: 0% introductory APR for 15 months on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening. After that, a variable APR will apply, 18.49% to 29.49%.

benefits.title: Travel Coverages
benefits.description: Eligibility for Travel Accident Insurance, Trip Cancellation and Trip Interruption coverage, Baggage Delay Reimbursement, Travel Emergency Services, and Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver.

benefits.title: Concierge Service
benefits.description: Concierge service is available 24 hours a day and provides personal assistance via telephone, including recommendations and reservations.

benefits.title: Free Online FICO Credit Score Access
benefits.description: Free online access to your FICO Credit Score lets you keep an eye on your credit score and get alerts when we learn that your score has changed.

notes: No annual fee. Visa Signature card (applicants not meeting credit criteria may receive a Platinum card with different benefits). Rewards: 2x on Princess purchases including onboard, 1x elsewhere. All rates/fees/benefits verified from official Barclays/Princess Cruises product page.
